lane: empty action region: schedule the next bounded action
primary_user: A home-exercise participant who needs deliberate pacing and remote control over a previously selected routine.
painful_workflow: After a pause or missing confirmation, a continuously playing routine advances without a clear, bounded agreement about what instruction comes next.
current_workaround: Repeatedly pause and seek the video or ask a helper to control playback; these are unvalidated workflow hypotheses.
imported_mechanism: m02 resource allocation and bounded repair combined with m01 event-order checks: compute and persist exactly one eligible next instruction.
data_sources: Original instruction media for one seated routine.
Participant-selected rest interval and session time budget.
Live local remote confirmations and playback events.
Generated cancellation, missing-prerequisite, expiry, and insufficient-budget fixtures.
core_computation: Represent one authored seated routine as instruction tasks with durations, prerequisite confirmations, participant-selected rest intervals, and an explicit session time budget. Derive eligible tasks from an ordered local event log; missing prerequisites block eligibility rather than imply completion. Enumerate start times for the next task and select the earliest feasible placement under explicit priorities. Persist a single pending action containing its instruction ID, prerequisites, due time, and expiry. Recheck prerequisites when it becomes due. Stop or cancellation invalidates the action; expiry requires renewed confirmation. If the action cannot fit, report the conflicting time budget and request permission before extending it.
last_mile_action: After participant approval, save and arm one in-session instruction appointment. At its due time, present a ready prompt; play only after fresh confirmation, then remove the completed appointment.
visible_transformation: An ambiguous paused routine becomes one inspectable next instruction with a start window, prerequisite evidence, cancellation control, and a bounded lifetime.
sponsor_dependency: Requires a functioning accepted Fire OS emulator or actual Fire TV. Hardware and emulator readiness remain unconfirmed; no AWS runtime or gated tooling is assumed.
technical_risk: Timer lifecycle and cancellation races could cause unwanted playback. Limit the prototype to foreground in-session scheduling, recheck state before execution, and expire pending actions after process restart. Remote reports cannot establish physical execution quality.
why_now: A supplied repository description explicitly identifies films without description tracks as an accessibility gap; the competition includes Fire TV.
killer_demo: On an accepted Fire OS emulator or Fire TV, confirm a completed instruction and schedule the next one after a short participant-selected rest. Show the saved appointment and countdown. Cancel it and prove no instruction fires. Reschedule, let it become due, confirm readiness, and play exactly one instruction. Remove a prerequisite and show scheduling refusal.
hard_to_fake_advantage: A persistent pending-action record and event log must agree with timer behavior, cancellation, expiry, and actual playback. A countdown alone cannot establish the promised bounded execution.
mutation_history: round 1: empty action region: schedule the next bounded action
track_fit: Fire TV primary track: a large-screen, remote-operated routine scheduler with persistent bounded actions and prerequisite checking. It addresses procedural pacing, not clinical effectiveness.

primary_user: A home crafter resuming an interrupted hot-glue work session.
painful_workflow: After an interruption, the crafter cannot establish whether the modeled workspace prerequisites still hold before resuming tool use.
current_workaround: Inspect the workspace and reconstruct the previous checks from memory; this is an unvalidated workflow hypothesis.
imported_mechanism: Replace the parent's recovery-policy comparison with a conservative transition guard that emits a counterexample trace when a requested transition lacks supporting evidence.
data_sources: Original, locally authored craft-session state machine and illustrative prerequisite rules.
Generated interruption, stale-confirmation, and conflicting-answer fixtures.
Session-local user confirmations.
core_computation: Represent one authored craft routine as a finite-state machine. Store each prerequisite confirmation with its source, session revision, and invalidation triggers. An interruption invalidates designated workspace checks. Before advancing to the tool-use step, evaluate the prerequisite predicates against the current evidence revision. Unknown, conflicting, or invalidated evidence blocks advancement. Emit the failed predicates and their evidence history; atomically recheck the revision when committing an allowed transition.
last_mile_action: Block the simulated transition into tool use, explain which confirmations became invalid, and request the specific checks needed before advancing.
visible_transformation: A remembered completed checklist becomes a blocked transition with an inspectable reason; fresh confirmations restore permission to advance within the simulation.
sponsor_dependency: Uses the supplied brief's Alexa+ simulation alternative; no gated Alexa+ tooling, hardware, AWS runtime, or optional mini challenge is required.
technical_risk: User confirmations can be false and authored guards can omit hazards. The prototype blocks only its own workflow transitions and cannot establish physical workspace safety. Language interpretation must never bypass deterministic guards.
why_now: A supplied repository description explicitly frames returning to a routine without starting over as an objective within the Alexa+ track.
killer_demo: Confirm workspace prerequisites, interrupt the session, and request resume. Show the blocked tool-use transition and its invalidation trace. Attempt to reuse an old confirmation and show rejection, then provide fresh confirmations and advance.
hard_to_fake_advantage: The transition log records evidence revisions and guard decisions. A stale confirmation or concurrent state correction must change the actual commit result, not just the assistant's wording.

primary_user: A community assistance adviser maintaining a conversational screening script.
painful_workflow: After editing a screening question or rule, the adviser needs to identify which conversation paths now produce inconsistent guidance before sharing the script.
current_workaround: Manually replay sample conversations and compare the resulting checklists; prevalence and cost require user validation.
imported_mechanism: Turn the parent's dependency lineage engine into a reproducible differential validation runner with independently authored expected outcomes and metamorphic checks.
data_sources: Two original fictional assistance-program rule versions.
Synthetic conversation transcripts with corrections and unresolved answers.
Separately authored expected-output manifest and metamorphic relations.
Generated execution traces and reproducibility manifests.
core_computation: Version two fictional program rule sets, normalized conversation transcripts, and an independently authored expectation manifest. Replay each transcript from a clean session against baseline and candidate versions. Compare resulting question paths, conclusions, and preparation tasks against explicit expectations. Check correction equivalence, irrelevant-answer invariance, and unresolved-input handling. Record input digests, engine version, rule version, execution parameters, and ordered events in a rerunnable result bundle. Report unexpected differences with a minimal failing transcript.
last_mile_action: Run a selected validation suite from the conversation and export a reproducible failure bundle identifying the script change and first divergent step for correction.
visible_transformation: An apparently harmless rule edit becomes a concrete failing conversation with expected and actual guidance; correcting the edit produces a new reproducible passing run.
sponsor_dependency: Uses the accepted Alexa+ simulation route without gated partner tools, physical devices, AWS access, or external benefits APIs.
technical_risk: A suite can miss undeclared dependencies, and an incorrect expectation manifest can bless incorrect behavior. Include deliberately faulty implementations and independent expectations; passing results establish only conformance to the fictional specification.
why_now: A supplied repository description connects benefits screening with consequential questions and subsequent steps, identifying a candidate workflow for investigation.
killer_demo: Ask the assistant to validate a candidate fictional-program script. A deliberate undeclared dependency causes a correction-equivalence test to fail. Open the minimal transcript, fix the dependency, and rerun the same manifest to demonstrate the changed result.
hard_to_fake_advantage: The exported bundle can be rerun from clean state. Expected outcomes are authored separately from implementation outputs, and a deliberate faulty rule must cause an observable failing assertion.
mutation_history: round 1: empty action region: run a reproducible validation test
track_fit: Alexa+ primary track through a functioning simulated conversational assistant that accepts a validation request, executes screening conversations, explains failures, and reruns corrected rules.

primary_user: Blind and low-vision Fire TV viewers preparing locally authorized films for offline viewing.
painful_workflow: Limited application storage cannot hold every film's audio-description assets, and a changed viewing plan leaves useful descriptions unavailable while unused assets occupy space.
current_workaround: Manually delete and copy description files. This workflow and its prevalence require viewer validation.
imported_mechanism: Parent concept-004-5; mechanism_05 changes from allocating narration time to minimum-cost repair of a finite offline-storage allocation. Workflow, resource model, data, last-mile action, and proof change.
data_sources: Entrant-created short films and separate authorized description audio bundles
Measured sizes and hashes of bundled files
Remote-entered viewing priorities and retention pins
Generated small-capacity and copy-failure fixtures
core_computation: Model description bundles with measured byte sizes, film dependencies, user-assigned retention priorities, and explicit pins. Enumerate allocations for a small catalog under an application-owned byte budget. Minimize declared eviction and missing-description costs while preserving pins and complete bundle dependencies. Compare the candidate against every feasible allocation to establish optimality for the bundled instance. Report infeasibility when pinned bundles exceed capacity. Execute additions through staging space included in the capacity model, then atomically replace the allocation manifest; failed copies preserve the previous usable allocation.
last_mile_action: After remote confirmation, reallocate the application's constrained storage by evicting selected unpinned description bundles and copying selected replacement bundles from a local staging source.
visible_transformation: A full cache missing descriptions for the next selected film becomes a different, capacity-compliant allocation whose playable description files match the displayed manifest.
sponsor_dependency: Requires functioning Fire OS execution on an accepted Fire TV emulator or actual device. Availability remains unverified; establish this before implementation. No cloud account or model access is needed.
technical_risk: Application-managed cache limits differ from operating-system free space. Both must be checked before copying. Atomic recovery and temporary-space accounting are the main implementation risks; usefulness requires viewer research.
why_now: A supplied repository description brings these operational concerns together; the competition's Alexa+ track permits a working simulated experience for examining the workflow.
killer_demo: On an accepted Fire TV emulator or device, select a different upcoming film under a deliberately small application budget. Show the optimal eviction/copy plan, approve it with the remote, and play the newly cached description. Then pin an oversized combination and show explicit infeasibility with no destructive changes.
hard_to_fake_advantage: The allocator changes actual files, accounts for temporary copy space, verifies file sizes and hashes, and makes the chosen description playable. A plan-only visualization cannot satisfy the demonstration.
mutation_history: round 1: empty action region: reallocate a constrained resource
track_fit: Fire TV primary track, with remote-operated allocation and actual local playback on Fire OS. No mini challenge selected.

lane: open a review task containing the minimal conflict set
primary_user: An author preparing remote-operated exercise-session navigation for older Fire TV viewers.
painful_workflow: A routine revision can introduce contradictory confirmation, timing, and transition rules, leaving viewers unable to advance. The author must locate the conflicting rules before publishing.
current_workaround: Manually replay navigation paths and inspect rule files. This authoring workflow is a hypothesis requiring validation.
imported_mechanism: Parent concept-005; combine mechanism_04's explicit temporal semantics with mechanism_05's inconsistent-plan diagnosis. Change the user from viewer to author, workflow from session recovery to prepublication review, data from session traces to versioned contracts, and action from replay to opening a review task.
data_sources: Entrant-authored three-step demonstration routine
Versioned confirmation, timing, and navigation contracts
Generated satisfiable, conflicting, and unsupported-rule fixtures
Actual remote navigation events from the bundled player
core_computation: Compile a three-step routine into a bounded transition model with explicit confirmation, ordering, and timeout semantics. Check whether each required target step is reachable within a declared horizon. For an unreachable target, enumerate subsets of the authored rules against fixed transition semantics and extract a minimum-cardinality subset that still prevents reachability; break ties deterministically. Include the fixed background assumptions and horizon in the result. Verify that every smaller subset permits a path. Missing or unsupported rule semantics produce indeterminate status rather than a conflict claim. Recheck against the routine version before creating a task.
last_mile_action: Open a persisted in-application review task containing the minimum conflict set, source rule IDs and versions, fixed assumptions, bounded reachability result, and suggested author decisions. Remote selection opens that task's detail view.
visible_transformation: A routine that silently strands the viewer becomes an actionable author review task containing only the smallest conflicting rule set under the declared model.
sponsor_dependency: Requires Fire OS on an accepted Fire TV emulator or device; readiness is unverified. Task storage is local, with no external issue-tracker account or API dependency.
technical_risk: Minimum-cardinality search grows exponentially, so restrict the demonstrator to a small explicit rule set. Results establish bounded navigation conflicts only; they do not assess exercise execution, clinical suitability, or safety.
why_now: A repository snapshot dated October 22, 2026 explicitly identifies films without description tracks as an accessibility gap.
killer_demo: On Fire OS, try a routine requiring confirmation before advancement while disabling confirmation throughout the only advancement window. Open the generated two-rule review task, show that either rule alone allows completion, revise one rule, and rerun the player to reach the next step.
hard_to_fake_advantage: The review task is generated from the same versioned rules executed by the player. Exhaustive subset checks support minimum cardinality for the bounded fixture, and the author repair changes actual navigation behavior.
mutation_history: round 1: empty action region: open a review task containing the minimal conflict set

primary_user: A household routine organizer deciding whether to change how a shared packing routine handles interruptions.
painful_workflow: Changing a routine for everyone requires choosing between frequent confirmations and repeated work, but a single successful resume provides no comparison of how the proposed rule behaves under other interruptions.
current_workaround: Hypothesized workaround: discuss preferences or try a new checklist informally. Existing practices and the frequency of this decision are unverified.
imported_mechanism: Parent: concept-007. Apply mechanism_06 as an on-demand intervention comparison rather than an automatic resume recommendation. Structural changes include a household organizer user, routine-redesign workflow, parameterized scenario data and an explicit counterfactual-comparison job as the last-mile action.
data_sources: Generated packing dependency model and bounded interruption scenarios.

core_computation: Represent one packing routine as a finite-state transition model. Let the organizer choose a baseline checkpoint rule and a proposed rule that adds a confirmation before a dependency-sensitive step. On an explicit comparison request, fork identical initial states and replay a small scenario set using matched exogenous interruption and item-removal events. Regenerate questions and actions separately for each policy. Report paired repeated-work, confirmation and unresolved-prerequisite differences, with a parameter sweep showing where the preferred rule changes. Keep scenario variation separate from model-assumption sensitivity.
last_mile_action: Trigger a persisted counterfactual comparison run from the conversational request, then save a decision card linking the baseline, proposed change, assumptions and reproducible paired traces; leave adoption to the organizer.
visible_transformation: A proposed routine change becomes an executable comparison with two synchronized timelines, explicit tradeoffs and a saved decision record tied to the exact scenario versions.
sponsor_dependency: Uses the supplied Alexa+ simulation alternative with AI-assisted development. No unavailable partner tools, hardware, external model service or AWS account is required.
technical_risk: A model can manufacture a policy advantage, and incorrectly shared policy-dependent events can invalidate the comparison. Separate external disturbances from generated actions, expose assumptions and include scenarios favoring each policy. Household demand remains unvalidated.
why_now: An October 22, 2026 repository description emphasizes decision-relevant questions and a step-by-step handoff, indicating contemporary developer attention to this workflow.
killer_demo: Ask the working Alexa+ simulation, 'Compare checking the bag after every interruption with checking only before departure.' Watch it launch a new comparison run. Show a stable-context scenario favoring fewer confirmations, then an item-removal scenario exposing that policy's unresolved prerequisite. Change one assumption and rerun to display the boundary where the tradeoff reverses.
hard_to_fake_advantage: Each run stores model and policy versions, matched exogenous event IDs and separately generated action histories. Judges can reproduce the comparison and inspect a scenario in which either rule loses.

lane: empty action region: write a verified correction into the workflow
primary_user: An accessibility reviewer correcting description timing while reviewing an original film on Fire TV.
painful_workflow: A reviewer hears a description overlap dialogue, but reporting the problem separately leaves the playback metadata unchanged and makes it difficult to establish whether the correction works.
current_workaround: Record timestamps in notes, edit a sidecar file elsewhere, reload the player, and listen again. This workflow is a hypothesis requiring reviewer validation.
imported_mechanism: m01: Verify a proposed metadata correction against temporal invariants before committing it, retaining a counterexample when it fails. Parent: concept-001. Changes user, workflow, mechanism, last-mile action, and proof.
data_sources: Entrant-created short clip and prerecorded description variants.
Entrant-authored dialogue intervals, event deadlines, and description metadata.
Generated valid, conflicting, missing-annotation, and stale-revision edit fixtures.
core_computation: Represent an authored clip's descriptions as versioned sidecar records with durations, delivery deadlines, precedence, and annotated dialogue exclusions. A remote-operated editor proposes moving one description or selecting an authored shorter variant. Check all affected invariants over the entire clip horizon. Missing timing annotations yield indeterminate and block verified status. Commit only a passing candidate using a revision check and atomic replacement; reread the persisted sidecar and verify it again. On rejection, show the conflicting intervals without modifying the active revision. Verification covers timing against supplied annotations, not description accuracy or completeness.
last_mile_action: Write the verified correction into the application's active description sidecar, reload playback from that revision, and retain an undo record.
visible_transformation: A reproducible dialogue collision becomes a persisted, verified timing correction that subsequent playback actually uses.
sponsor_dependency: Requires a functioning Fire OS device or accepted emulator; availability remains unconfirmed. Validate that route before implementing the editor. No other sponsor runtime or gated tooling is required.
technical_risk: Audio synchronization, remote focus, and atomic persistence are implementation risks. Correct annotations remain an external assumption; passing the checker cannot establish semantic accessibility quality.
why_now: An October 22, 2026 repository description emphasizes decision-relevant questions and a step-by-step handoff, indicating contemporary developer attention to this workflow.
killer_demo: On Fire OS, play an original clip with an intentionally overlapping description. Attempt an invalid correction and show rejection. Commit a valid correction, restart the application, and replay the corrected interval from the persisted revision. Undo restores the original revision and its detected collision.
hard_to_fake_advantage: The correction must survive restart, match the displayed sidecar revision, and change audible playback. Rejected edits must leave the persisted file unchanged.

lane: empty action region: schedule the next bounded action
primary_user: An older adult using Fire TV to follow an already selected, authored exercise routine with explicit pauses and readiness confirmations.
painful_workflow: After an interruption, the viewer must decide where to resume and manually coordinate the next instruction, rest interval, and readiness confirmation.
current_workaround: Pause the video, estimate a rest interval, and manually seek to the next instruction. This is a plausible workaround rather than a validated finding.
imported_mechanism: m02: Allocate the next instruction to a bounded user-approved time window under precedence and exclusion constraints, with explicit infeasibility and permitted repair. Parent: concept-002. Changes mechanism, workflow, data, last-mile action, and demonstration proof.
data_sources: Original instruction assets and explicit sequencing/rest metadata for one previously selected routine.
Live remote completion, availability, readiness, and stop events.
Generated scheduling fixtures for incompatible windows, missing confirmation, expiry, and duplicate timer delivery.
core_computation: For one authored routine, enumerate candidate start times for the next instruction within a short explicit scheduling horizon. Inputs are the current routine step, confirmed completion events, routine-defined minimum rest, user-selected availability window, and stop state. Require predecessor confirmation, completed rest, and no active stop; missing confirmation blocks scheduling. Choose the earliest feasible slot under these hard constraints. If none exists, display the conflicting bounds and offer a user-approved wider availability window without relaxing routine prerequisites. Persist a single pending action with an expiry and revision token. At its due time, recheck prerequisites and present a readiness prompt; movement playback begins only after fresh remote confirmation. Expiry or stop cancels the pending action.
last_mile_action: Persist and arm one bounded next-instruction action. At the scheduled time, deliver a readiness prompt in the running Fire TV app, then play that instruction only after fresh confirmation.
visible_transformation: An interrupted routine becomes one inspectable pending action with a due time, expiry, prerequisites, and cancel control.
sponsor_dependency: Requires a working Fire OS device or accepted emulator, currently unconfirmed. No Bee-origin data, Ring interface, AWS runtime, or model access is needed.
technical_risk: Timer delivery and lifecycle handling can be unreliable when the application is suspended. The prototype schedules only while the app remains active; restart marks an overdue action expired and never autoplays it. Self-reported progress cannot establish movement quality or exercise suitability.
why_now: An October 22, 2026 repository description explicitly centers geographically separated family participation and photos arriving from multiple phones.
killer_demo: Complete an authored instruction, choose a window shorter than its required rest, and show the scheduling conflict. Approve a wider window and show the pending action being stored. At its due time, demonstrate that playback waits for readiness. Repeat with stop and expiry to prove neither can trigger movement playback.
hard_to_fake_advantage: The displayed schedule must correspond to a persisted pending record and actual timer behavior. Due-time revalidation, cancellation, expiry, and duplicate-trigger prevention must visibly change execution.
mutation_history: round 2: empty action region: schedule the next bounded action
track_fit: Fire TV primary track: remote-operated routine scheduling and execution on Fire OS, with an explicit bounded-action state machine. No clinical or physical-form assessment claim and no mini challenge selected.

primary_user: A maintainer validating changes to a conversational assistance-screening workflow.
painful_workflow: After changing a screening rule, the maintainer must determine whether conversational corrections produce the same result as a fresh evaluation and whether unrelated outputs change unexpectedly.
current_workaround: Manually replay conversations and compare screenshots or checklists. Its prevalence is unverified.
imported_mechanism: Transform parent concept-004's applicant-facing lineage checklist into a maintainer-operated differential validation runner. Combine dependency invalidation with matched replay from m03; change user, workflow, mechanism, last-mile action, and proof type.
data_sources: Original rules for two explicitly fictional assistance programs.
Synthetic profiles and deterministic conversational correction scripts.
Independently authored expected boundary-case results.
Local execution traces and version metadata.
core_computation: For two fictional programs, execute versioned correction scripts through the conversational session engine. After each correction, compare incremental results with a separate full-recompute evaluator using identical normalized inputs and rule versions. Check independently authored expected outputs for boundary cases, stale-result exposure, and unaffected-output preservation. Canonically serialize the fixture bundle, versions, results, and event ordering so another run can reproduce the result.
last_mile_action: Run a selected validation suite from the conversation, return failing case identifiers and replayable transcripts, and export a reproducible validation bundle for the maintainer.
visible_transformation: An unverified rule edit becomes a reproducible pass/fail report with a concrete correction sequence that exposes any inconsistent result.
sponsor_dependency: Select the supplied Alexa+ simulation alternative without assuming a particular model provider, gated SDK, hardware, AWS credentials, or optional mini challenge.
technical_risk: Both evaluators may share a rule interpretation bug. Keep their evaluation paths separate and add independently specified expected cases. Passing fictional fixtures does not establish real-program eligibility accuracy or complete dependency coverage.
why_now: A supplied October 22, 2026 repository description explicitly identifies returning to everyday routines without starting over as its objective.
killer_demo: Introduce an intentionally faulty invalidation edge. Ask the simulated assistant to validate the rule update, expose a mismatch after a household-answer correction, export the failing bundle, repair the edge, and rerun that unchanged bundle successfully.
hard_to_fake_advantage: A separate full-recompute implementation and hand-authored expected cases provide checks beyond the incremental engine's own dependency declarations. The same exported bundle must reproduce the failure before repair and pass afterward.

primary_user: Blind and low-vision viewers preparing accessible local videos for offline viewing on a storage-constrained Fire TV.
painful_workflow: When available storage shrinks, viewers must decide which downloaded description assets to remove without losing essential descriptions for their planned viewing.
current_workaround: Manually delete downloads or retain fewer videos. Demand for this specific workflow remains unvalidated.
imported_mechanism: Parent concept-004-5; mechanism_05 changes from narration scheduling to minimum-cost reallocation of a finite offline description-storage budget. Workflow, data, last-mile action, and proof change.
data_sources: Entrant-created short local videos
Entrant-recorded full and compact description packs
Measured pack sizes and authored essential-event coverage manifests
Explicitly labeled app-budget reduction fixtures
core_computation: Model each original video as requiring one compatible description pack selected from authored full and compact alternatives with measured byte sizes and declared event coverage. Enumerate pack assignments under the measured app storage budget, preserving all viewer-pinned essential-event requirements and minimizing explicit quality-loss and replacement costs. Report infeasibility when mandatory coverage cannot fit. For the small bundled instance, exhaustive enumeration establishes the minimum modeled cost.
last_mile_action: After remote confirmation, stage the selected replacement packs, verify their hashes and coverage manifests, atomically switch the active allocation, and delete superseded packs. Retain the previous allocation if staging fails.
visible_transformation: An over-budget offline library becomes an executable allocation showing which videos retain full descriptions, which receive compact packs, and the resulting storage use.
sponsor_dependency: Requires Fire OS and an accepted emulator or actual Fire TV. Availability and acceptance of the intended emulator remain unverified; check these before implementation. No AWS or model access is required.
technical_risk: Atomic replacement temporarily needs staging space, which must be included in feasibility checks. Authored coverage declarations do not establish description quality or viewer benefit.
why_now: A supplied October 22, 2026 repository description explicitly identifies films without description tracks and the need to preserve dialogue as an accessibility concern.
killer_demo: On an accepted Fire TV emulator, reduce an app-level storage allowance. Show the solver replace one full pack with a compact pack, apply the allocation, then play the affected video offline with its essential descriptions intact. Tighten the allowance again to produce explicit infeasibility.
hard_to_fake_advantage: The allocation changes actual local assets used by playback. Measured bytes, hashes, coverage manifests, and exhaustive enumeration make the result inspectable.
mutation_history: round 2: empty action region: reallocate a constrained resource
track_fit: Fire TV primary track: remote-operated offline accessibility asset management and actual playback on Fire OS. No mini challenges selected.

primary_user: A facilitator preparing an authored television exercise session for older adults.
painful_workflow: Timing, ordering, and explicit-confirmation rules can contradict one another before a session starts, leaving the facilitator unsure which rules require review.
current_workaround: Inspect the routine script and test navigation manually. The prevalence and burden of this authoring problem remain hypotheses.
imported_mechanism: Parent concept-005; mechanism_04 supplies explicit temporal-contract semantics, while mechanism_05 supplies constraint-conflict extraction. User, workflow, data, mechanism, last-mile action, and proof change from live session recovery to pre-session review.
data_sources: Entrant-authored three-step routine with placeholder movement content
Explicit transition, timing, and confirmation rules
Generated contradictory-rule and missing-definition fixtures
Actual local review-task and remote-edit events
core_computation: Compile a three-step authored routine into finite transition and timing constraints. Decide whether any session trace can satisfy every rule. If inconsistent, enumerate constraint subsets by increasing cardinality and return a smallest unsatisfiable subset, with stable rule IDs and source locations. Verify satisfiability after removing each member. Missing timing definitions or unbounded semantics yield an indeterminate authoring result rather than an invented conflict. Runtime confirmation means reported progress only.
last_mile_action: Open and persist a local review task containing the minimum conflict set, linked routine fields, solver semantics, and a reproducible fixture. Let the facilitator edit a cited rule with the remote, rerun validation, and close the task only when the revised complete routine is satisfiable.
visible_transformation: A routine that cannot satisfy its own rules becomes a focused review task identifying the smallest contradictory rule set and the exact fields requiring a decision.
sponsor_dependency: Requires Fire OS and accepted Fire TV hardware or emulator; readiness remains unverified and must be checked first. Local task persistence avoids external account dependencies.
technical_risk: Minimum conflict size is relative to the explicit bounded constraint model, and multiple equally small conflicts may exist. Contract consistency does not establish exercise safety, movement quality, or user demand.
why_now: A supplied October 22, 2026 repository description brings vehicle readiness, border documentation, maintenance risks, and empty return trips into the same operational context.
killer_demo: On Fire OS, load a routine requiring confirmation before advancing while also forcing an unconditional timed advance incompatible with its authored confirmation window. Open the generated review task, inspect the cited rules, edit one, and show a valid example trace. Then introduce a second independent conflict to show that repairing the first does not prematurely close the task.
hard_to_fake_advantage: The review task is generated from executable constraints and includes a cardinality-minimal conflict certificate relative to the bounded model. Its lifecycle depends on rechecking the entire edited routine.
mutation_history: round 2: empty action region: open a review task containing the minimal conflict set

primary_user: A household member choosing how an assistant should handle interruptions in a shared packing routine.
painful_workflow: Before adopting an automatic resumption policy, the user cannot see how that policy behaves when another household member changes the packed items during an interruption.
current_workaround: Hypothesized workaround: try a reminder or checklist and adjust it after failures. Neither actual behavior nor the frequency of these failures is established by the supplied evidence.
imported_mechanism: Parent concept-007; opp-007 × mechanism_06. Changes workflow from immediate resumption to policy rehearsal, data from one interaction trace to a bounded scenario matrix, and last-mile action from offering a next step to triggering a counterfactual comparison.
data_sources: Generated four-item shared packing routine with explicit prerequisites.
Generated bounded scenario matrix covering no removal and removal of each previously packed item.
Local comparison requests, assumption edits and persisted run manifests.
Supplied opp-007 evidence and repository description, used only as workflow inspiration.
core_computation: On an explicit comparison request, snapshot the routine state and fork it into restart and prerequisite-check policies. Enumerate a small declared set of externally removed-item scenarios, preserving identical initial states and exogenous event IDs across each pair. Regenerate policy-dependent questions and packing actions separately. Report paired repeated-step counts, confirmation counts and unresolved prerequisites without collapsing them into an unexplained score. Recompute when the user changes one assumption.
last_mile_action: Trigger and persist a counterfactual comparison job from the conversation, then open its paired traces and assumption-specific outcome table.
visible_transformation: A vague preference about resuming becomes a reproducible comparison run showing exactly when each policy repeats work, asks questions or leaves a prerequisite unresolved.
sponsor_dependency: Use the supplied Alexa+ simulation route with a local tool-using agentic workflow; no gated partner tooling, AWS service or external model access is assumed.
technical_risk: An unrealistic transition model can manufacture apparent advantages. Publish the bounded assumptions, preserve only genuinely exogenous events across branches, regenerate policy actions, and show tradeoffs. Exhaustive fixture coverage does not establish real-world causal effects.
why_now: A supplied repository description identifies selective eligibility questioning and subsequent application planning as a current workflow focus.
killer_demo: In the simulated Alexa+ experience, pause a shared packing routine and ask, 'Compare restarting with checking what changed.' Show the generated comparison run. Change the assumption from no item removal to one removed item and rerun, exposing the changed tradeoffs and the event responsible.
hard_to_fake_advantage: Executable state transitions, preserved exogenous-event identities and complete enumeration of the declared small scenario set let judges reproduce every reported difference and inspect a scenario where checking adds unnecessary burden.
mutation_history: round 2: empty action region: trigger a counterfactual comparison
track_fit: Alexa+ primary track through a working entrant-built simulated experience that interprets comparison requests, asks for assumptions, executes paired replay and explains the resulting traces.

testable_claim: For every scenario in the declared bounded fixture, a comparison request creates two branches with identical initial state and exogenous disturbances, independently regenerates policy actions and reports reproducible outcome differences. Results describe the explicit model, not measured household effects.
demo_proof: Show a run ID, model version, initial-state digest, matched exogenous event IDs and separate policy-generated actions.
